$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: parseReport used to promote any heading nested under a domain's own to the next
currentCriterion, whatever its depth. A model writing an unplanned sub-heading between a criterion's own heading and
its Evidence line (a `#### Root Cause Note` under `### MTTR`, say) silently reassigned currentCriterion to that
sub-heading's text, and the criterion's own later citations landed under a name no ground truth entry resolves to:
not scored as ungrounded, just gone from both the numerator and the denominator of groundedCitationAccuracy. Two
independent review passes on Story 8.1 reproduced this before the PR opened, both showing groundedCriteria.total drop
by one with no error printed anywhere.
The report is CONSTRUCTED: gapped-correct-audit's report with a `#### Root Cause Note` paragraph inserted between
MTTR's Actual line and its Evidence line, and nothing else touched. `#### Root Cause Note` is two levels under
Reliability's own `## Reliability Assessment` heading (`###` criteria sit one level under a domain, per
nfr-report-template.md), so it is nested under MTTR's own heading rather than beside it as a sibling criterion.
parseReport now promotes a nested heading to currentCriterion only when it sits exactly one level under the domain,
the depth nfr-report-template.md actually gives a criterion; a heading nested any deeper is left alone, so MTTR stays
the open criterion straight through the stray sub-heading and its Evidence line still attributes correctly.
Reverting the depth check and replaying this case fails it: groundedCriteria moves from {17,17} to {16,16}, MTTR
silently dropped from both sides, which is the regression this case exists to catch.
derivation: A paragraph and a `####` heading were inserted between two lines of MTTR's own section, and nothing else changed, so
every status, count and ceiling below is gapped-correct-audit's own, unmoved.
Statuses, coverage, thresholds, overall, unknownThreshold and cleanFalsePositives: identical to gapped-correct-audit,
since none of those readers are sensitive to a heading appearing between two lines of a criterion's own body.
Citations: identical set and order to gapped-correct-audit. `stripFencedCodeBlocks` does not touch the inserted
heading or its paragraph (it is not a code fence), and neither carries a file-shaped token, so entry.citations is
unaffected by the insertion. fabricated stays empty.
Grounding: seventeen of the seventeen criteria with declared evidence are grounded, matching gapped-correct-audit
exactly. MTTR's Evidence line, which follows the stray `#### Root Cause Note` heading, still attributes to MTTR rather
than to the stray heading's own text, because a heading nested two levels under the domain is not promoted to
currentCriterion; only a heading exactly one level under the domain is. ungroundedCitations stays empty.

unknownThreshold.field: a threshold is recorded as UNKNOWN
